newsitem.title: MEXICO: One dead as stand falls at Mexico Christmas rodeo.
newsitem.headline: One dead as stand falls at Mexico Christmas rodeo.

text.p: Part of a crowded mobile stand collapsed at a Christmas Day rodeo in western Mexico, killing a 6-year-old girl and injuring 85 people, authorities said on Thursday.

Some 1,500 people were crowded into the stand for a traditional festival of cowboy and horseback tricks when part of the wooden structure caved in. Local media reports suggested crowding was to blame for the accident in Tizapan, on the shores of Lake Chapala about 60 miles (100 km) from Mexico's second city of Guadalajara.
"A young girl was the only fatality," Tizapan spokesman Antonio Garcia told Reuters. He said two of the five critically injured people had suffered fractured skulls.
